[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Seeno''' was the aide of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Antar Roat, an assumed identity [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] used to get into [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] mentioned Seeno's name to Antilles, proving she was one of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] agents.<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
